function.name: update_assignment
function.description: Updates an existing coursework/assignment in Google Classroom (e.g. extend deadline, change points, edit title or instructions). Pass only the parameters being changed. Never invent assignment_id; call get_assignments first to locate the specific assignment.

assignment_id.description: The unique assignment (courseWork) identifier obtained from get_assignments.

title.description: New title for the assignment. Provide only if renaming.

description.description: New or revised task description and requirements.

max_points.description: Updated maximum points. Must be an integer greater than or equal to 0.

due_date.description: New deadline date formatted strictly as 'YYYY-MM-DD'. If the user gives a relative date ('до пятницы', 'на неделю позже'), resolve the exact date using get_current_time.

due_time.description: New deadline time in 24-hour format 'HH:MM' (e.g. '23:59' or '18:00').

state.description: Updated assignment state. Use 'PUBLISHED' to publish an assignment currently in draft.
